pages.title: Invoice Dispute Workflow
pages.compiledTruth: Invoice Dispute Workflow owner is Revenue Ops Team. Invoice Dispute Workflow uses LedgerLink for exception tracking. Refund Policy applies to Invoice Dispute Workflow. Escalations route through Revenue Ops Team.
pages.timeline: 2024-03-15: Alex Rivera owned Invoice Dispute Workflow before Revenue Ops Team took over.

pages.title: Revenue Ops Team
pages.compiledTruth: Revenue Ops Team owns Invoice Dispute Workflow and handles dispute escalations.

pages.timeline: 2024-03-15: Alex Rivera owned Invoice Dispute Workflow.

pages.title: LedgerLink
pages.compiledTruth: LedgerLink is the system used by Invoice Dispute Workflow for exception tracking.

pages.title: Refund Policy
pages.compiledTruth: Refund Policy applies to Invoice Dispute Workflow and governs refund exceptions.

pages.title: Payroll Export Pipeline
pages.compiledTruth: Payroll Export Pipeline is supported by PayFlow Vendor for payroll file delivery. Payroll Export Pipeline depends on LedgerLink for reconciled invoice states.

pages.title: PayFlow Vendor
pages.compiledTruth: PayFlow Vendor is the outside provider that supports Payroll Export Pipeline and handles payroll file delivery.

pages.title: Payroll Policy
pages.compiledTruth: Payroll Policy mentions Payroll Export Pipeline but does not provide the payroll file delivery service.

pages.title: Legacy Ledger
